dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' shaped light-gray perimeters with jagged, high-frequency edges; sharp pixel-intensity gradients transition from dark-valued exterior regions to light-valued annular structures on the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, asymmetrical light-pixel clusters located on the anterior-dorsal region and neck, appearing as solid-intensity points without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface form an irregular quadrilateral with its primary axis aligned horizontally.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, interconnected reticulated lattice of high-intensity pixels forming a honeycomb-like pattern on the anterior third of the dorsal surface.
